body:
**Requesting repo:** gsmlg-opt/gaoxy on branch `codex/m4-http3`

**Severity:** blocker

Gaoxy M4 needs to preserve ordered request trailers when translating H1/H2/H3
downstream requests to an explicitly selected HTTP/3 origin. HTTP Fetch 0.21.3
cannot send these trailers through its public upload API. The corresponding
`elixir_quic_http3` package is sourced from this repository and exposes no public
request trailing-HEADERS operation either.

With an independent aioquic 1.2.0 HTTPS/H3 origin on loopback, using its generated
CA and localhost certificate, the following declaration-free diagnostic reaches
the real upload and reproduces the functional gap:

```elixir
url = System.fetch_env!("H3_ORIGIN_URL")
ca = System.fetch_env!("H3_ORIGIN_CA")
{:ok, upload} = HTTP.Stream.start_link(0)
promise = HTTP.fetch(url <> "/echo",
  method: :post, body: upload, duplex: :half,
  http_version: :http3, http3_reuse: false, redirect: :manual,
  request_mode: :proxy, stream_response: true, decode_body: false,
  ssl: [cacertfile: ca, verify: :verify_peer], timeout: 3_000)
:ok = HTTP.Stream.chunk(upload, "abc", 1_000)
:ok = HTTP.Stream.finish(upload, [{"x-check", "one"}, {"x-check", "two"}])
HTTP.Promise.await(promise, 4_000)
# => {:error, :request_trailers_unsupported}
```

The origin waits for request FIN before responding. Its independent trace
observed exactly one request, DATA `abc` (SHA256
`ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad`),
no trailing fields and no request FIN. Repeating without `chunk/3` observed one
zero-DATA request, the same asynchronous error, and no trailers/FIN. `finish/2`
returning `:ok` therefore does not mean the trailing HEADERS were delivered.

Adding `headers: [{"trailer", "x-check"}]` instead fails before origin HEADERS,
with `ArgumentError: Trailer request headers are not supported` from
`HTTP.Request.reject_unsupported_request_framing!/1`, reached through
`HTTP.HTTP2.request_headers/3` and `HTTP.HTTP3.Stream.headers/1`.

Expected behavior: a supported public H3 upload operation preserves ordered,
repeated trailing fields after DATA or zero DATA, sends exactly one terminal
HEADERS/FIN and reports asynchronous failure through the existing public result.
Valid declarations should not be rejected as H1-only framing. Preserve cancellation,
finite deadlines and no replay; no private transport handle is required by this
request.

Local reproduction environment: Elixir 1.18.5, OTP 28.5.0.7 / ERTS 16.4.0.6,
HTTP Fetch/runtime/core and QUIC/H3 cohort 0.21.3, aioquic 1.2.0. Gaoxy source
parent is `29d79f95b78d112a1d8e1661d108b788f7780f3f`; the uncommitted harness
records exact source hashes and wire events in
`docs/acceptance/evidence/m4/upstream-contract/run-1791811050964927834/result.json`.
That bounded execution ran seven rows: five supported rows passed and these two
required request-trailer rows are blocked. Public children terminated normally
and both origin UDP ports rebound. Historical failed attempts remain preserved.

Gaoxy's production H3 upstream adapter and full upstream proxy matrix are blocked
pending a published compatible fix; no local trailer-dropping workaround is enabled.
title: [internal] Support ordered HTTP/3 request trailers through public upload APIs
